Indian Stock Market Rally 2026: Why did the Sensex surge 2,009 points in a single day, adding nearly ₹8 lakh crore to the market value of listed companies? Is the Indian share market finally recovering after months of losses?
In today's episode of Kharcha Pani, we explain why the Sensex and Nifty rallied sharply after the US midterm election results, how the Democrats' victory and Donald Trump's political setback affected global markets, and why falling crude oil prices and returning Foreign Institutional Investors (FIIs) have boosted Indian stocks.
